AerialAttackDamageAMod.name: From Above
AerialAttackDamageAMod.effect: From Above causes Aerial Attacks to deal an additional 10 Damage.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 20 Damage.

AttackSpeedMod.name: Swift Strike
AttackSpeedMod.effect: Swift Strike increases the weapon's Attack Speed by 15%.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 30%.

BlockingLessStaggerMod.name: Fortified
BlockingLessStaggerMod.effect: Fortified reduces the amount of Stagger the Envoy receives upon Blocking attacks by Foes.  When Double-Stacked, Stagger reduction provided by Fortified will be doubled.

CassidDamageOnNearDeathMod.name: Invader
CassidDamageOnNearDeathMod.effect: Invader increases the Damage dealt to Foes with less than 30% Life by a TBD amount.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled.

CassidDamageOnUndamagedMod.name: First Strike
CassidDamageOnUndamagedMod.effect: First Strike grants an additional 20 Damage against Foes who are at full Life.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 40.

CassidParryStaggerMod.name: Clam's Foot
CassidParryStaggerMod.effect: Clam's Foot causes Parries to deal additional Stagger to the parried Foe.  When Double-Stacked, the Stagger bonus will be doubled.

CassidPoisonMod.name: Sickness
CassidPoisonMod.effect: Sickness grants all strikes a 10% chance to proc Poison status on hit.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 20%.

ConsecutiveAfterHeavyMod.name: Follow Up
ConsecutiveAfterHeavyMod.effect: Consecutive light attacks following any Heavy Attack will accumulate bonus Damage by +7 Damage per hit, up to a maximum of +28 Damage on the final hit.  For example, the first follow-up strike will deal +7 Damage, the second will deal +14, the third +21, and the fourth +28.

DamageNoSidearmMod.name: Unencumbered
DamageNoSidearmMod.effect: Unencumbered provides a consistent 14 Damage buff to the Weapon when the Envoy has no Sidearm equipped.  When Double-Stacked, this buff will be doubled to 28 Damage.

DamageWhenFullHealthMod.name: Hale and Hearty
DamageWhenFullHealthMod.effect: Hale and Hearty causes attacks to deal an additional 12 Damage when the Envoy is at full Life.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 24 Damage.

DeflectDamageMod.name: Arcane Rebound
DeflectDamageMod.effect: Arcane Rebound causes magick projectiles that are Deflected using Mirrorspell to deal ~20% more Damage.  When Double-Stacked, this damage bonus will be doubled to ~40%.

DendritFireDamageMod.name: Enkindled
DendritFireDamageMod.effect: Enkindled grants a 10% chance to proc the Ablaze status on hit.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 20%.

DendritHealOnKillMod.name: Renewed Slayer
DendritHealOnKillMod.effect: Renewed Slayer heals the Envoy by 5 Life per second for 4 seconds after slaying a Foe.  When Double-Stacked, the healing will be doubled to 10 Life per second, over the same 4-second duration.

DendritRegainDecayMod.name: Well Woven
DendritRegainDecayMod.effect: Well Woven doubles the amount of time Regain Potential (the yellow bar) remains stationary prior to decay.  As Regain Potential begins to decay after 5 Seconds by default, this results in a new total of 10 Seconds prior to decay.

DendritRegainMod.name: Hunter's Relish
DendritRegainMod.effect: Hunter's Relish increases the amount of Life recovered from Regain Hits by +2% of Damage dealt.  As Regain Hits restore 20% of their Damage as Life by default, this results in a new total of 22% healing, up to the current Regain cap shown by the yellow bar.

DodgeAttackDamageMod.name: Rejoinder
DodgeAttackDamageMod.effect: Rejoinder causes all Dodge Attacks, including Spectre Strikes, to deal 10 more base Damage before multipliers, and additional unknown stagger damage.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 20.

DodgeFocusMod.name: Grounding Spell
DodgeFocusMod.effect: Grounding Spell Allows the Envoy to dodge once in any direction whilst keeping the Grounded pact art active.  When Double-Stacked The Envoy can dodge twice before disrupting Grounded.

FeyDuplicateProjMod.name: Duplicate
FeyDuplicateProjMod.effect: Duplicate provides a 9% chance for projectile-based Magick attacks to be duplicated.  When Double-Stacked, the chance will be doubled to 18%.

FeykinArcanicDamageMod.name: Aftershock
FeykinArcanicDamageMod.effect: Aftershock does not directly add any additional Damage to the weapon; it instead simply grants a 10% chance to proc the Arcanic status effect on each hit.  Arcanic Status deals 100% of the hit's damage over 2 ticks, for 50% damage per tick that are affected by Enemy Armour.

FeykinDamageToNearbyMod.name: Sympathy Pang
FeykinDamageToNearbyMod.effect: Sympathy Pang deals 10% additional Damage to a nearby Foe on hit.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 20%.

FocusedHeavyAttackDamageMod.name: Conjuration
FocusedHeavyAttackDamageMod.effect: Conjuration increases heavy cast by +30 Damage when fully Grounded.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to +60 Damage.

HeavyAttackDamageAndStaggerMod.name: Full Force
HeavyAttackDamageAndStaggerMod.effect: Full Force increases Heavy Attack Damage by 15.  It also increases Stagger damage by an unknown amount.

HeavyAttackWindUpMod.name: Breakneck
HeavyAttackWindUpMod.effect: Breakneck increases Heavy Attack Charge rate by 15%.  This also includes Rune activation, as it shares the Heavy Attack animation.

HeavyCastWindUpMod.name: Arcane Alacrity
HeavyCastWindUpMod.effect: Arcane Alacrity increases Heavy Attack Charge rate by 10%.  This also includes Rune activation, as it shares the Heavy Cast animation.

LegShotMod.name: Severed Root
LegShotMod.effect: Severed Root increases leg shot stagger by X When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 2X.

MagickHeavyAttackDamageAndStaggerMod.name: Arcane Barrage
MagickHeavyAttackDamageAndStaggerMod.effect: Arcane Barrage causes Heavy Casts to deal an additional 10 Damage, and ??? additional Stagger.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 20.

MendicantBleedDamageMod.name: Savagery
MendicantBleedDamageMod.effect: Savagery grants attacks a 10% chance to proc the Bleed status on hit.  Bleeding Foes take Damage-over-time equal to 20% the attack's damage each tick, for 5 ticks.

MendicantFearMod.name: Unnerving Blow
MendicantFearMod.effect: Unnerving Blow provides a X% (Currently unknown) chance on hit to inflict the Fear status.  When Double-Stacked, this chance will be doubled.

MendicantFearThrowMod.name: Sinister Volley
MendicantFearThrowMod.effect: Sinister Volley provides a X% (Currently unknown) chance to inflict the Fear status on a Foe struck by a Thrown attack.  When Double-Stacked, this chance will be doubled.

MendicantWeaknessMod.name: Hollowed
MendicantWeaknessMod.effect: Hollowed grants 10% chance on hit to reduces the amount of Damage the Envoy will receive from a Foe by 20% for 8 seconds.  When Double-Stacked, the chance will be doubled for a total of 20% chance.

OdeReduceDefenseMod.name: Bypass
OdeReduceDefenseMod.effect: The first strike against a foe will reduce Enemy Armour by 10.  When Double-Stacked, this reduction increases to 20.

OdeStaggerToKnockdownMod.name: Slinger's Tempo
OdeStaggerToKnockdownMod.effect: Upon Staggering a Foe, Slinger's Tempo grants a 10% chance to instead send them into a full knockdown state.  This will allow the Envoy to perform a Ground Finisher instead of a regular Finisher.

OdeVoltaicDamageMod.name: Galvanic Strike
OdeVoltaicDamageMod.effect: Despite its in-game description, Galvanic Strike does not add any additional Damage to the weapon.  It instead simply grants a 10% chance to proc the Voltaic status effect on each hit.

ParryWindowMod.name: Heightened Parry
ParryWindowMod.effect: Heightened Parry increases Parry Window by an unknown amount.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled.

RiposteDamageMod.name: Vengeance
RiposteDamageMod.effect: Vengeance grants 15 additional Damage when executing a Riposte, prior to the weapon's Riposte Multiplier.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 30.

ShatterDamageMod.name: Rupture
ShatterDamageMod.effect: Rupture increases the Damage dealt by embedded arrows that are splintered by the Splinter Combat Art by 8 damage, and also increases the Stagger damage dealt by bows.  It is unconfirmed whether the Stagger damage applies to all shots, or just to Splinter.

SprintAttackDamageMod.name: Bounding Swipe
SprintAttackDamageMod.effect: Bounding Swipe causes Sprint Attacks to deal an additional 12 Damage, and ??? more Stagger.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 24 Damage and ??? Stagger.

StaggerCritMod.name: Cowp
StaggerCritMod.effect: Cowp grants a 10% chance for the amount of Stagger dealt by a Weapon attack to be doubled.  When Double-Stacked, the chance to proc this effect will be doubled to 20%.

StaggerMod.name: Swooning Blow
StaggerMod.effect: Swooning Blow causes hits to deal an additional 12 Stagger Damage.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 24.

ThrowSpeedMod.name: Streamlined
ThrowSpeedMod.effect: Streamlined increases a Melee weapon's Throw Speed by 20%.  When Double-Stacked, this bonus will be doubled to 40%.
